title: eludite/nuget/restore
description: Restore the open solution or the projects named out of process (`dotnet restore`, MSBuild's Restore target), with the lock-file rule and the session's credentials passed to it as NuGet's NuGetPackageSourceCredentials_<source> variables. Its output goes out as eludite/nuget/update `output` notifications; the answer comes when it ends.

generation.description: The solution generation the call is issued under (host-rpc.md, "Solution generation"). A value that is not current is -32801; a generation change while the call runs cancels it with -32801.

operation.description: The shell's id for this call (from 1): eludite/nuget/update notifications and eludite/nuget/credentials requests caused by it carry it, so the shell can route the Package Manager output and know who asked.

projects.description: Absolute paths of projects of the open solution. Omitted: every project the solution lists.

lockFiles.description: The setting nuget.lockFiles. respect (the default): when a project has packages.lock.json, a restore that changes nothing runs with `--locked-mode` and a change updates the lock file (`--force-evaluate`); ignore: restore runs without either.

force.description: Re-evaluate every dependency (`--force-evaluate`), updating lock files.

interactive.description: Whether the shell may be asked for credentials (eludite/nuget/credentials) during this call: true for the person's calls, false (the default) for agents', whose calls fail with `credentials_required` instead. Credential providers run either way.

commandLine.description: The `dotnet restore` command line the host ran.

lockedMode.description: Whether `--locked-mode` was used (a lock file existed under `respect` and nothing changed).

lockFiles.description: The packages.lock.json files of the restored projects that exist after the restore.

items.description: A restore error or warning, for the Error List (source `nuget`).

code.description: NuGet's code (NU1101, NU1605, NU1903, ...) or MSBuild's.

file.description: Absolute path of the file the diagnostic is reported against (a project file for NuGet's own).
